metadata.question: Was the sulfer dioxide concentration higher over Cumbre Vieja than the Funchal Island on October 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Dataset: Sentinel-5P (TROPOMI) for SO2 concentration - Date: October 18, 2021 - Locations: * Cumbre Vieja (La Palma, Canary Islands): ~28.0°N, -17.84°W * Funchal Island (Madeira): ~32.76°N, -17.0°W - Note: Cumbre Vieja erupted on September 19, 2021, so SO2 should be elevated on Oct 18. 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for Sentinel-5P; it measures atmospheric SO2 column density - Extract SO2 values at both locations 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - If either collection is empty (no TROPOMI data for that day), output C1 - If pixel count is 0 after processing, output C2 - If SO2 values are None/NaN or invalid (negative or unrealistic), output C3 - Compare mean SO2 values: If Cumbre Vieja > Funchal, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries const cumbreaVieja = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.84, 28.0]); const funchalIsland = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.0, 32.76]); // 2. Date range const date = '2021-10-18'; const startDate = '2021-10-18'; const endDate = '2021-10-19'; // 3. Load Sentinel-5P SO2 data const so2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_SO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = so2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`S5P SO2 Images (Oct 18, 2021): ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No S5P SO2 data available for October 18, 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get the first image (NRTI should have daily coverage) const so2Image = so2Collection.first().select('SO2_column_number_density'); // 5. Extract SO2 values at Cumbre Vieja const so2CumbreaStats = so2Image.sample(cumbreaVieja, 10000).first().getInfo(); const so2Cumbrea = so2CumbreaStats ? so2CumbreaStats.properties.SO2_column_number_density : null; // 6. Extract SO2 values at Funchal Island const so2FunchalStats = so2Image.sample(funchalIsland, 10000).first().getInfo(); const so2Funchal = so2FunchalStats ? so2FunchalStats.properties.SO2_column_number_density : null; console.log(`Cumbre Vieja SO2: ${so2Cumbrea !== null ? so2Cumbrea.toFixed(4) : 'null'} mol/m²`); console.log(`Funchal Island SO2: ${so2Funchal !== null ? so2Funchal.toFixed(4) : 'null'} mol/m²`); // 7. Validation if (so2Cumbrea === null || so2Funchal === null || isNaN(so2Cumbrea) || isNaN(so2Funchal)) { console.log('Invalid or missing SO2 values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (so2Cumbrea < 0 || so2Funchal < 0) { console.log('Negative SO2 values detected (invalid).'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Comparison const difference = so2Cumbrea - so2Funchal; console.log(`Difference (Cumbre Vieja - Funchal): ${difference.toFixed(4)} mol/m²`); if (so2Cumbrea > so2Funchal) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
